title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Smoky, lime-marinated chicken seared hot with peppers and onions, served in warm tortillas with your favorite toppings.

image.alt: A skillet of sizzling chicken strips with peppers and onions, with tortillas

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the lime juice, 1 tbsp of the oil, the chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Let it sit for {time 15 min} while you slice the vegetables.

Heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet over high heat until smoking. Add the peppers and onion and cook, stirring only now and then, until charred in spots but still a little crisp, {time 5-6 min}. Move to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil and the chicken in a single layer. Sear without moving for {time 2 min}, then stir and cook until browned and cooked through, {time 3-4 min} more.
Return the vegetables to the pan and toss together for {time 1 min}.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in foil in the oven. Serve the fajitas straight from the skillet with the tortillas, sour cream, salsa and avocado.

notes: A very hot pan is what gives fajitas their char; don’t crowd it, or they’ll steam. Cook in two batches if needed.
